title: Gaming Cafe Price Per Hour in India (2026)
description: Gaming cafe price per hour in India: about ₹40-120 for a PC and ₹100-200 for a PS5, by city and setup. Rates in Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune and more.
tags: PS5 gaming cafe price per hour

body.text: Gaming cafe charges in India usually work out to about ₹40-120 per hour for a gaming PC and ₹100-200 per hour for a PS5, based on rates published by cafes across Indian cities in 2026. Premium setups cost more. The exact price depends on your city, the hardware and how many players share a console, so here is what decides the rate and what cafes charge in major cities.
Gaming cafe price per hour: typical ranges

items: Budget PC (older GPU, 144Hz monitor): about ₹40-80 per hour.
Mid-range or high-refresh PC: about ₹80-120 per hour.
Premium PC (latest GPU, 240Hz): ₹100-200 per hour at top cafes.
PS5: about ₹100-200 per hour, sometimes billed per controller.
VR and racing rigs: usually billed higher than PCs; check each cafe.

body.text: Rates published by cafes and cafe listings in 2026 give a rough picture of what each city charges per hour:

items: Bangalore: ₹40-80 for standard PCs; ₹100-200 at premium cafes.
Mumbai: PS5 at about ₹120-200.
Pune: PCs from ₹60 to ₹120; PS5 from ₹70 per controller to ₹150.
Hyderabad: PS5 zones at premium cafes around ₹150-200.
Noida: about ₹100 for PCs and ₹150 for PS5.
Indore: about ₹80 for a standard PC, ₹100+ for flagship stations, ₹120 for PS5.

body.text: These are examples, not fixed prices. Rates change, and two cafes on the same street can charge very differently.

items: Hardware: a high-end GPU and 240Hz monitor cost more per hour than a budget setup.
City and area: metros and busy neighbourhoods charge more.
Per player or per console: some cafes bill a PS5 per controller, so playing with a friend can double the cost.
Time of day: many cafes offer cheaper weekday or off-peak hours and night packages.
Packages: multi-hour bundles and memberships cut the hourly price.

body.text: How to pay less per hour

items: Play on weekdays or off-peak hours when cafes run discounts.
Ask about multi-hour packs and memberships.
Pick the hardware you need: a budget PC is fine for BGMI-style esports titles or older games.
Split a console with friends where the cafe bills per screen, not per controller.
Earn HashCoins on every booking and redeem them on passes and offers.
